subject: Multi-cloud GTM: SKU allocation, packaging and region mapping for marketplace listings

Subject: Multi-cloud GTM: SKU allocation, packaging and region mapping for marketplace listings

Team —

Following up from last week's GTM sync: we need to lock SKU granularity and packaging per cloud so that marketplace listings + co-sell motions are aligned. I attached the current proposal (sku_proposal_v3.xlsx) and exported a short PDF matrix (sku_matrix_v3.pdf) to make the trade-offs obvious. High level asks:

- Decision: single global SKU with pricing tiers vs. cloud-specific SKUs (separate AWS/Azure/GCP listings).
- Region mapping: which regions should we launch first per cloud (US/EU/APAC subset)?
- Packaging: bundle inference + optimize (core) vs. feature-based add-ons (KV cache, dedicated burst).
- Co-sell: what should the co-sell pricing delta be (list vs. partner net) and who will own the marketplace storefront ops?

Quick thoughts in the spreadsheet — my recommended default: AWS & Azure have separate SKUs for enterprise/standard/dev to match their marketplace SKU models; GCP gets a simpler two-tier SKU (standard/enterprise) for launch, with APAC-specific pricing bands. Reasons: differences in billing models, marketplace UI constraints, and co-sell rebate structures. But this is a proposal — need consensus before we hand off to Partner Ops and Legal for listing creation.

Can everyone reply with a short vote + one-line rationale by EOD Monday PST? Aisha/Diego/Priya — any platform-specific constraints we should call out now?

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sku_proposal_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), sku_matrix_v3.pdf (summary)

Subject: Re: Multi-cloud GTM: SKU allocation, packaging and region mapping for marketplace listings

Karthik — quick vote and rationale: YES to cloud-specific SKUs for AWS and Azure; YES to simpler two-tier for GCP.

Rationale:
- AWS Marketplace requires more SKU-level granularity to support private offers and AMI/Container listings; having an Enterprise/Standard/Dev SKU maps better to how customers search.
- Azure Marketplace supports plan-level entitlements (so separate SKUs = clearer billing and co-sell reporting).
- GCP's marketplace is more restrictive on multiple listed SKUs in certain regions; start with two and expand after telemetry.

Region suggestion (MVP):
- AWS: us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1 (launch 1)
- Azure: EastUS, WestEurope, SoutheastAsia (launch 1)
- GCP: us-central1, europe-west1 (launch 1)

Packaging: core inference + cache as base bundle; advanced features (dedicated burst, analytics retention, SLA tiers) as feature add-ons. This lets us keep the SKU count manageable while enabling price jumps for larger customers.

Co-sell pricing: recommend 20% partner net delta for initial co-sell incentive; we can iterate. I'll attach the quick matrix I used.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Product, Cloud GTM
Redwood Inference

Attachment: sku_matrix_v3.pdf

Karthik / team —

Thanks for the clear ask and the attachments — helpful. A few AWS-specific notes from our side:

- Private Offers & Co-sell: Private Offers can handle per-account pricing but listing creation benefits from clear plan-level SKUs (Enterprise / Standard / Dev). That aligns with Marcus' suggestion.
- Regional availability: AWS Marketplace allows global listings but some procurement teams request region-labeled pricing for tax/transfer reasons. Launching in us-east-1 + eu-west-1 + ap-southeast-1 is common. If you want to prioritize US/EMEA first, that's fine.
- Billing models & meter types: If you plan to meter usage (tokens/minutes) vs. flat monthly seats, let us know — metering increases listing complexity and can delay approval.
- Co-sell: AWS GTM requires a partner case with estimated ACV and a coherent partner discount. The 20% delta is ok for sizing, but we usually ask partners to have a standard published list price and provide partner net in private offer flow.

Next steps from AWS: please share the finalized SKU matrix (CSV) and the initial pricing bands. Also include an org-level contact for listing ops (we need a person for the Marketplace request form).

Aisha
Aisha Kumar
Principal Partner Manager, AWS ISV Partners

Thanks everyone — consensus captured. Short summary & next steps: 

Decisions: 
- AWS & Azure: enterprise / standard / dev SKUs (cloud-specific listings).
- GCP: two-tier launch (standard / enterprise), expand after telemetry.
- Packaging: base bundle = inference + KV cache; add-ons = dedicated burst, analytics retention, SLA tiering.
- Regions (MVP): AWS: us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1; Azure: EastUS, WestEurope, SoutheastAsia; GCP: us-central1, europe-west1.
- Co-sell pricing guidance: start with 20% partner net delta; final pricing file to come.

I've uploaded the consolidated file to Drive and attached a short brief (co-sell_pricing_brief.docx). Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2SkuMatrix.
